_readme: Hand-picked testimonials from outside Google (Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, email...). The daily Google sync never edits this file, so these always stay in the Testimonials deck. After editing, run: node scripts/sync-reviews.mjs. Full guide: REVIEWS.md.

testimonials.author: Shop Local Montgomery
testimonials.text:
Congratulations to the Montgomery Small Business Initiative!
It’s great to see Montgomery Township, NJ High School students using their talents and initiative to connect with and gain real-world experience in our local business community.
